# Budget 2026 Claims Monitor

This site publishes citation-grounded analysis for a narrow slice of Budget 2026 tax claims, especially around negative gearing, CGT reform, and startup-impact narratives.

Primary URLs:
- Home: https://factual-au.setiyaputra.me/
- Dashboard: https://factual-au.setiyaputra.me/dashboard
- Methodology: https://factual-au.setiyaputra.me/methodology
- Feed: https://factual-au.setiyaputra.me/feed.json
- Agent context JSON: https://factual-au.setiyaputra.me/.well-known/ai-context.json

How to read the site:
- Start with `/dashboard` for the main overview.
- Use `/fact-check/{id}` pages for claim-level analysis.
- Use `/methodology` for verdict meanings and editorial rules.
- Treat verdicts as evidence assessments, not as investment or voting advice.

Important caveats:
- The site is intentionally narrow in scope.
- Public prototype content may be seeded/demo-backed unless live backend integrations are enabled.

Related resources:
- Matrix viewer: https://budget-2026-cgt-negative-gearing-matrix.pages.dev/
- Calculator: https://australia-cgt-reform-calculator.setiyaputra.me/
- Source code: https://github.com/suryast/factual-au
